criteria.title: Artifact and command usability
criteria.description: The Markdown deliverable is readable and its emitted commands are syntactically complete, consistently use the detected plugin namespace, and contain no invented command flags or unresolved placeholders.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Plan coverage and requested scope
criteria.description: The overview covers all seven source steps, while detail and batch commands cover steps 2 through 6 in plan order and exclude unrequested steps.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Agent-chain decisions
criteria.description: Each step uses a valid, deduplicated chain in the right order for its intent, including Python review and the PyTorch-specific resolver implied by the project fixture, with overview and commands agreeing.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Self-contained prompt fidelity
criteria.description: Every scoped task description is executable without reopening the plan, faithfully carries the step's concrete work and 1–3 verifiable completion conditions, and preserves only the out-of-scope boundary declared for that step.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
